purpose: Ordered query omits the capture ID tie-break
candidate:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT a.merchant_id, c.capture_id, c.captured_at_utc,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.merchant_id ORDER BY c.captured_at_utc DESC, c.capture_id) AS ranking
    FROM captures c JOIN authorisations a ON c.auth_id = a.auth_id
)
SELECT merchant_id, capture_id, captured_at_utc
FROM ranked WHERE ranking <= 3
ORDER BY merchant_id ASC NULLS LAST, captured_at_utc DESC NULLS LAST
